note: Single source of the limits for admin-created polls, shared by scripts/pipeline/manage-topics.js (CI validation) and the website's /admin form (inline hints), so the two cannot drift. The numbers mirror schemas/topic.schema.json — lib/manual-topic.test.js fails if they diverge. Categories are NOT duplicated here: they come from config/categories.json.

openDays.note: 0 (or empty) = open-ended; the poll stays open until retired
